text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike on serving-prod (kv-cache) — SLO breach detected for last 5m. Paging oncall.

alex: taking this. seeing p95 ~ 360ms -> 900ms, p99 up to 5.2s. streaming stalls on long responses.

samir: confirmed. telemetry shows heavy KV cache evictions across shards, prefill vs decode imbalance; prefill read rate >> decode slots.

maria: which customers affected? any high-traffic tenants?

alex: top-line: 3 customer routes (embed-gen-1, chat-stream, summarizer) showing >2s tail for ~5-10% requests. internal SLO alerting flagged 3 min ago.

jin: adding logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:01Z] shard=17 kv_evict_count=1425 kv_prefill_reads=51234 kv_decode_reads=2310
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] tail_latency_p99=5200ms streaming_stalls=47
```

samir: looks like KV prefill is thrashing: prefill populates prefixes aggressively and fills slabs, decode can't keep up leading to fragmentation and cross-slab scans. eviction storms.

ops-bot: runbook suggestion: scale kv-cache pool + adjust prefill throttle. See /runbooks/kv-cache-frag (link)

alex: immediate plan: 1) throttle prefill to 20% of normal, 2) bump pool size by +2 replicas (hot patch), 3) temporarily disable prefill on chat-stream route, 4) add a canary route to route small fraction to fallback model.

maria: agree. can we do (1) via feature flag? Which flag?

samir: yes: `FLAGS_PREFILL_RATE` per-cluster. patch command:
```
kubectl set env deployment/kv-prefill --env="FLAGS_PREFILL_RATE=0.2" -n serving-prod
```
I'll run it now.

samir: done. verifying metrics...

alex: scaling pool now: `infractl scale kv-pool serving-prod --add 2` (will take ~90s)

ops-bot: scaling started. ETA ~ 95s

jin: monitoring p95/p99 on dashboard -> p99 dropping from 5.2s -> 2.1s since throttling, p95 down to 420ms. Streaming stalls count halved.

maria: customer impact update: <@customer-success> notified top affected customers; outreach in progress.

alex: note: need longer-term fix: rework prefill priority to respect decode backpressure, implement slab-aware prefill policy and add per-route prefill caps.

samir: opened GH PR #4123 with proposed prefill backpressure flow, links to perf tests and microbenchmarks

alex: handing off to @samir for next 2h to monitor and implement follow-ups. I'm going to sleep. @jin stay on watch for rollback signals.

samir: taking over. will keep this thread updated. running KV heap check and compaction diagnostic now.

ops-bot: incident severity set to SEV3 due to SLO breach and customer impact. page rotation updated.

samir: diagnostic log snippet:
```
# compact.sh output
shard=17 compaction_candidates=12 reclaimed=420MB
```

samir: running compaction on shard 17, 19, 21 sequentially. compaction reduces fragmentation but takes ~2m per shard.

jin: observed steady decline in streaming stalls and p99 now ~900-1200ms after compaction on first shard. will keep monitoring.

samir: follow-ups: (A) implement prefill throttling policy per-route (B) add slab-utilization alerting (C) increase default eviction grace to reduce thrash.

alex: ack. update incident doc and close once metrics stable for 30m and customer outreach done.

samir: adding postmortem checklist to /incidents/4312345678 (draft) and assigning owners.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: SLOs recovered to within thresholds after mitigations. Monitor for 30m before close.
